source.title: From axiomatics to intrinsic characterization: Some open problems in computable analysis

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with trailing identifier 1306138. Local shard metadata identifies the exact work as Marian Boykan Pour-El, "From axiomatics to intrinsic characterization: Some open problems in computable analysis", Theoretical Computer Science 219(1-2), pages 319-329, 1999, DOI 10.1016/S0304-3975(99)00294-7.

failure_mode=blocked_or_challenged. Direct local fetching of https://zbmath.org/1306138 returned an HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge, and subsequent local fetch attempts for zbMATH API/OAI hosts failed with DNS resolution errors in the sandbox. The browser/page reader did not expose a readable zbMATH record body for the exact URL.

failure_mode=metadata_only. Exact DOI recovery reached the ScienceDirect article landing page, which visibly confirmed the title, author, journal, DOI, open-archive status, and abstract. However, the readable HTML body exposed only abstract-level statements that five open problems exist and did not expose the complete problem statements needed for extraction. Known ScienceDirect PDF endpoints could not be downloaded in the local shell because outbound DNS was unavailable, and the browser/page reader did not return a readable PDF artifact.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched by the exact title, DOI, PII S0304397599002947, and zbMATH identifier. Candidate pages inspected or surfaced included ScienceDirect, DBLP, CCA Net bibliography, Utah TeX bibliography, OpenAlex/Crossref-derived local rows, MaRDI citation listings, and Cambridge references. These were rejected because they were landing pages, bibliographic metadata, abstracts, citation lists, snippets, or references to the work rather than readable full-text source artifacts containing the open problems.

No candidate question was accepted because the workflow forbids extracting technical questions from abstracts, bibliographic metadata, search snippets, or citation-only pages when the complete problem statements are not visible in the chosen source text.
Saved exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/1306138.json and outputs/latest.json.
